subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Lesson 6: Culture and Project – Famous railways
outcomes: Find facts about the Haramain High-Speed railway and the Trans-Siberian railway.
Compare the two railways using numbers and facts.
Present a railway route with notes and interesting facts.

tf.s: The Haramain railway connects Makkah and Madinah.
tf.why: Yes, and it also stops at Jeddah.

tf.s: Haramain trains can travel at 300 kilometres an hour.
tf.why: Yes, it is a high-speed railway.

tf.s: The Trans-Siberian railway is less than 1,000 kilometres long.
tf.why: It is more than 9,000 kilometres long.

tf.s: You need pyjamas on the Trans-Siberian train because you sleep on it.
tf.why: Yes, the journey takes many days.

tf.s: Lake Baikal is the deepest lake in the world.
tf.why: Yes, you can see it from the train.

tf.s: The Trans-Siberian journey starts and finishes in Africa.
tf.why: It starts in Europe and finishes in Asia.

tf.s: The Haramain railway is a slow railway.
A railway map should show where the route starts and finishes.
tf.why: Yes, start and finish are important.

tf.s: When you present, you should sound bored.
tf.why: Sound interested so others are interested too.

tf.s: The Haramain railway is longer than the Trans-Siberian railway.
tf.why: About 450 km is much shorter than 9,000 km.

boxes.q: In which country is the Haramain railway?
boxes.why: Makkah and Madinah are in Saudi Arabia.
Haramain trains go 300 km an hour.

boxes.q: About how long is the Haramain railway?
What is Lake Baikal famous for?
o: It is the deepest lake in the world.
It is the smallest lake in the world.
boxes.why: You pass it on the Trans-Siberian.

boxes.q: What is the special number for the Trans-Siberian?
boxes.why: It is a very long railway.

boxes.q: Write 300 kilometres an hour with the abbreviation.
Why do you need pyjamas on the Trans-Siberian?
boxes.why: It is a long journey with nights on the train.

boxes.q: How many continents does the Trans-Siberian go through?
Why should you sound interested when you present?
o: So other people will be interested too.

boxes.why: It goes from Europe to Asia.

hunt.q: Go from one side to the other
A route has a start and a …
Project: draw the route on a …

mcq.q: What kind of railway is the Haramain railway?
mcq.why: Its trains travel at 300 km an hour.

mcq.q: What can you see from the Trans-Siberian train?
mcq.why: The train passes the deepest lake in the world.

mcq.q: What should a railway map show?
o: start, finish, length and things to see
only the colour of the train
the price of food on the train
mcq.why: These help people understand the route.

mcq.q: Which city is the Haramain railway's extra stop?
A train travels at 300 km an hour. How far does it go in 2 hours?
Which is a good note for a railway map?
o: The Rocky Mountaineer runs from Vancouver to Banff in Canada.
mcq.why: A good note gives the route and country.

mcq.q: You are going on the Trans-Siberian. What should you pack?
mcq.why: You sleep on the train for many nights.

mcq.q: Which railway is better for a quick trip between two cities?
mcq.why: It is high-speed and much shorter.

mcq.q: The Haramain railway is about 450 km. The Trans-Siberian is more than 9,000 km. What can we say?
o: The Trans-Siberian is about 20 times longer.

mcq.q: Why might someone prefer the Trans-Siberian journey?
o: You start in Europe and finish in Asia.
It is the fastest train in the world.
It is a very short trip.
